question: As per SOFIA-2020 data of FAO, the largest producer of fish in the world is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**China**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **China **is the **ruler of the world's largest fish producer**.
 
• **This Panda country **leaves far away from **its competitors**, **including India **with a **distance of six times more**.
 
• With a **total global fish production **of **178.8 million tons**, **one-third **of the **world's fish production **comes from **China**.
 
• The **Food and Agriculture Organization **of the **United Nations **is **a specialized agency **of the United Nations.
 
• It leads **international efforts **to **defeat hunger **and **improve nutrition **and **food security**.
 
• It was **founded **on 16 **October 1945**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Top **fish-producing countries in 2022**:

 
 
• China
 
• India
 
• Indonesia
 
• Peru
 
• USA
 
• Chile
 
• Japan 
 
• Thailand
 
• Vietnam
 
• Russia
